place.en: The bank of the Si River

setup.zh: 指尖触到它的一瞬，银光化作一个少女，睁开了眼睛。
setup.en: The moment your fingers touch it, the light becomes a girl, and she opens her eyes.

text.zh: ……你是谁？我好像睡了很久很久。我叫银月——除了这个名字，什么都想不起来了。
text.en: …Who are you? I think I slept for a very long time. My name is Yinyue — and that is all I remember.

text.zh: 你身上有灵气在长。很慢，但在长。我该怎么称呼你？
text.en: There is qi growing in you. Slowly — but growing. What should I call you?

exits.means: gives a name to be called by, or picks one of the offered names

text.en: {daohao}. A good name. I will remember it.
